thread:
emma: Heads up - docs PR #507 is blocked. I added an SDK example that shows opt-in for external fallbacks but I'm not sure the client API surface matches runtime flags. Can someone from runtime confirm the client snippet?
liam: share the snippet pls. quick: runtime exposes routingPolicy.allowExternalFallbacks boolean at deployment-level and the SDK has routeOptions.externalFallbacks for per-request overrides. need to confirm names.
emma: snippet here:

```
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.generate(route='critical', input='ping', route_options={'externalFallbacks': True})
```

emma: PR language says "set to true for external fallback". should we change to note deployment-level override?
ola: putting hold. If we merge as-is customers might think per-request toggles override tenancy defaults. Default behavior: Dedicated/Private block external fallbacks unless deployment policy allows it.
liam: runtime-bot can you confirm exact field names and precedence?
runtime-bot: Runtime config: deployment.routingPolicy.allowExternalFallbacks (bool, default: false for Dedicated/Private, true for Hosted). Request precedence: request.route_options.external_fallbacks overrides request-level only when deployment routingPolicy permits. Field name mapping in SDK: route_options.externalFallbacks -> request.route_options.external_fallbacks.
preview-bot: docs preview for PR #507 available: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr/507 (status: success)
emma: ok thanks. I'll update prose to: "Per-request external fallback flags are subject to the deployment's routing policy; for Dedicated/Private deployments the default is off and cannot be bypassed unless the deployment admin enables it"
liam: please also add a small table or bullet with precedence order: 1) deployment.routingPolicy 2) request.route_options 3) SDK convenience flag mapping.
ola: once updated I'll approve. Also add a tiny note about quantization compatibility checks (architecture, seq-len, KV cache).
emma: pushed edits + added SDK mapping note and brief precedence bullets. PTAL.
liam: LGTM, wording clear.
ola: approved, merging in merge window. Tagging release notes for migration guide later. :shipit:
